purpose: Repeat the retained-success control and new failed input under a newly created local OS temporary directory to isolate Dropbox/workspace filesystem context from the FACETS executable and input data.

execution.temporary_root: new directory from the OS temporary-directory provider
execution.only_change_to_each_spec: replace Scorefile with an absolute path inside the same temporary probe directory

interpretation.both_fail: FACETS executable/runtime interaction persists outside Dropbox; filesystem location is not sufficient remediation
interpretation.both_pass: Dropbox/workspace execution context is the localized cause; supplemental calibration may use a separately registered short temporary work root

claim_boundary: Execution localization only; no endpoint is read, no registered attempt is overwritten, and no calibration is replaced.
